title: Retire legacy gateway endpoints and prune versioned rollout configs
creator: Mariana Cortez
description: Remove the remaining compatibility gateway endpoints and obsolete versioned rollout config artifacts that complicate routing, increase runtime config surface area, and cause unexpected fallbacks. This ticket covers the code removal of the /v0 admin proxy routes, consolidation of multiple rollout manifest shapes into the canonical route-manifest schema, DB migration to compress rollout metadata, and automation to delete stale feature-gate translations. Goal: shrink runtime config branching, reduce query surface, and eliminate a maintenance burden that increases rolling upgrade risk.
acceptance_criteria: All legacy admin gateway routes (/v0/admin/*, /compat/feature-gate) removed from the gateway service and code compiles without compat flags
Route manifest schema migration completed and validated: no remaining v0/v1 mixed manifests in production namespaces
Database migration completed and rolled back if anomalies detected; migration job idempotent and monitored
No increase in 5xx rate or tail latency (>99th) in the two-week canary window compared to baseline
Feature-gate translation layer deprecated; any dependent clients either migrated or recorded in blocker list
tasks: Audit: enumerate endpoints and API consumers referencing legacy routes
Write migration: normalize route manifests and generate canonical fingerprints
DB migration job: compress rollout_metadata table and add version_fingerprint column
Gateway: remove compat proxy handlers and associated feature-flag shims
Create safety: 48h fallback toggle and short-lived compat proxy image for emergency re-enable
Automated tests: unit, integration, and end-to-end smoke tests against staging
Canary rollout: 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 3 days with monitoring checks
Cleanup job: garbage collect orphaned rollout artifacts older than 180 days
progress_updates: 2026-02-15: Scoping complete. Inventory doc created in Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/ENG/legacy-route-inventory
2026-02-18: Migration prototype merged to branch 'route-manifest-migration' (PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4321). Works end-to-end on staging with synthetic manifests.
2026-02-22: Discovered two internal infra services still calling /compat/feature-gate; contacted owners and created follow-ups (see comments).
2026-02-26: DB migration dry-run executed against a snapshot; job took 42m. Estimated production runtime ~3h with batching. Backout plan validated.
2026-03-01: Gateway compat handlers removed behind feature flag 'compat_proxy_disabled'. Starting 5% canary on dedicated staging cluster tomorrow.
risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Undiscovered clients still depend on removed endpoints. Mitigation: two-week delayed full removal, telemetry hooks to detect client errors, and emergency compat image to re-enable within 1 hour.
Risk: DB migration causes lock contention. Mitigation: run in small batches during low-traffic window and use application-level backoff for writes to rollout_metadata.
Risk: Rollout manifest conversion may change routing semantics. Mitigation: Fuzz tests and traffic shadowing to compare decisions before switching live routing.
testing_plan: Unit: verify schema conversions and serializer/deserializer parity
Integration: exercise gateway routing using converted manifests against canary pods
Load: run wrk-based load tests with representative token sizes to validate latency/throughput
Chaos: restart control plane during canary to validate graceful recovery and no config corruption
monitoring_and_alerts: Alerts: pager if gateway_compat_5xx > 0.5% for 10m or migration job error rate > 1%
SLO checks: compare 99th latency for text-generation API pre- and post-change
rollback_plan: If critical errors detected, flip 'compat_proxy_disabled' flag to false to re-enable compat handlers
Run DB rollback script to restore previous rollout_metadata snapshot (S3 path captured in migration runbook)
Re-route traffic to previous runtime version using the deployment pinning dashboard
notes: Do not delete the compat proxy image until 14 days after metrics are clean in production
Coordinate release with SRE for maintenance window and ops-runbook handoff
Notify customer success for any customers on older Dedicated contracts who may rely on legacy routes
